# CareMatch

> CareMatch is a trust-first marketplace that matches older adults and their families with verified in-home helpers for companionship, personal care, housekeeping, errands, and respite care across the United States.

CareMatch verifies every helper across five continuous stages: identity proofing with liveness selfie, national multi-jurisdiction background check, credential and license verification for skilled roles, continuous monthly re-verification, and live selfie plus GPS check-in at the start of every single visit. Families see the same verified profile the senior sees. Seniors approve every family action — family members propose, seniors decide. Concierge support is available 24/7 by phone at 1-800-CAREMATCH for anyone who prefers to talk instead of type.

Pricing is transparent: household help $18–$26/hr, companionship $20–$28/hr, personal care $24–$34/hr (CNA/HHA), skilled care insurance-billable. Monthly plans start around $800.

## Services
- [All services](/services): The full spectrum of in-home care
- [Companionship](/services/companionship): Conversation, activities, walks, appointment company ($20–$28/hr)
- [Personal care](/services/personal-care): Bathing, dressing, mobility, medication — CNA/HHA ($24–$34/hr)
- [Housekeeping](/services/housekeeping): Cleaning, laundry, meal prep ($18–$26/hr)
- [Errands & transport](/services/errands): Grocery, pharmacy, rides to appointments ($20–$28/hr)
- [Respite care](/services/respite-care): Short-term relief for family caregivers ($22–$30/hr)
